chapters.title: Chapter 482 - We are old acquaintances
paragraphs: "Seraphine? Good! I've been trying to marry that girl off to someone for a long time! Hahahaha." The old man laughed even harder.
His reaction was certainly something no one there expected. Did Lucios really like that young man that much?
He ignored the looks he received from the other thrones, as well as the pleas for permission to punish Qingyi.
He treated them as little more than annoying ants, because, in his eyes, that was exactly what they were.
The bronze dragon in the skies roared, silencing everyone. It was better not to insist while that old man was still in a good mood.
After all, when his mood soured, no one there would want to be around him or have him angry for any reason.
'Oh... Of course, Seraphine had to be one of his granddaughters... Qingyi repeated in his mind.
He had already forgotten that the old man did not support the current patriarch of the draconic elves and Lord of the Grand Duchy of Vaeldrinn without reason.
Lucios was his father.
That would only make it even more difficult to get rid of that bastard.
The handsome young man gritted his teeth, remaining determined and holding his head high.
Lucios sat back down on his throne, watching Viola, Seraphine's guard.
"Do you agree with this choice?" He asked.
Viola trembled, her knees almost giving way, but she just bowed her head thoughtfully.
"Yes, Lord Lucios!" Viola finally declared forcefully, raising her head.
So, it was decided. No one there would even dare to try to take Qingyi from her.
She just hoped that this was the right person.
"Very well, prepare for the next match." Old Lucios waved to the combatants, snapping them out of their stupor.
Qingyi nodded, stepping down from the concrete platform that soon began to recover.

He sat in a corner, ignoring all the looks of envy and greed directed at him. Any attempt at friendship was met with nothing but cold silence. Some even seemed to have positive intentions, but Qingyi simply couldn't be bothered to separate them from the other filthy, greedy vermin.
For some reason, his heart was beating faster than normal.
"Am I anxious about this?" Qingyi wondered.
It had been so many years since he had felt his body tingle with real anxiety that it seemed strange.

Perhaps he was just happy to know that soon he would be able to wipe away the anguish from the heart of his beloved Elize. For he knew well that on that day, the only tears she would shed would be tears of happiness, never again tears of longing.
What would be his value as a man if he couldn't even provide that for his beloved wives?
With a sigh, Qingyi watched the fights with a bored expression.
No other fight was as interesting, not after the duel between him and Lux.
Some even raised eyebrows among the many thrones, but that was the limit.
At the end of it all, they were lined up, each throne choosing its own champion in random order.
There were some disputes over the most talented, even the unconscious Lux being the target of greed, but these fights did not escalate much under Lucios' stern gaze.
The young men there couldn't help but be disappointed to realize that the powerful warrior of the twelfth ring did not seem interested in taking a champion after Qingyi's refusal.
Obviously, no one showed it.
In the end, fifty champions were quickly selected, and the rest were directed to the exit with downcast eyes.
Everyone followed their new masters, and Qingyi was no different, joining Viola.
The guard said nothing to him. Beneath her black steel mask, she seemed to have a complicated expression.
Silently, she walked to the huge platform.
With Qingyi by her side, their bodies were swallowed by a powerful spatial distortion, the mana around them changing shape
immediately.
When Qingyi realized it, they were already in a completely different place. The density of mana surrounding him exploded, the air filling his lungs even purer than before.

They were right in front of a mansion surrounded by lush, well-kept gardens, even though the mansion itself had long been abandoned. Viola would normally take him directly to the patriarch, but she took a small detour.
Immediately, Qingyi heard the unmistakable sound of steel sliding against steel. A noble and elegant elven saber appeared in his vision, pressing against his throat.
"What is your motivation with Lady Seraphine?" Viola demanded,
pressing her saber a little harder, just enough to draw blood.
To her surprise, Qingyi did not move, and his skin did not yield.
It was as if the saber could not cut him.
She retreated slightly, but Qingyi did not react.
After a moment of thought, the handsome young man replied briefly,
"We are old acquaintances."
"Acquaintance? With Lady Seraphine? Since when have you known each other?" Viola questioned, her face filled with even more
suspicion.
How could she believe that this strange foreigner had already been in
contact with her mistress?
"That is a question you should ask Lady Seraphine herself, not me.
She will tell you everything that needs to be said." Qingyi's voice
hardened, slightly irritated.
He had neither the time nor the inclination to deal with whatever nonsense this woman was spouting.
Viola gritted her teeth, gripping her sword even tighter.
She held the blade to Qingyi's neck for another moment before
stepping back.

It was large enough that its towers served as a cradle for a huge red-scaled beast. Its scales were covered in scars, its right eye replaced by a flaming void.
"This must be RedDeath... Qingyi repeated in his mind.
He watched as the bronze dragon landed beside the crimson dragon,
the two exchanging angry roars before beginning to ignore each other's presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 Where is she?
paragraphs: "What are you waiting for? Come in! My son doesn't have all day." Lucios declared, moving his old bones and paying no attention to Viola's slight dissent.

The old man guided the young champions, the thrones following close behind, ensuring that no one stepped out of line.
They were led through a well-defended courtyard, through large double gates, and then down a wide, luxurious, dimly lit corridor.
When he reached the doors leading to the throne room, Lucios finally stopped, stepping aside.
With a flick of his finger, the doors opened to reveal their spacious interior.
Rows of large, powerful pillars supported the central structure, its ceiling rising in a concave shape.
The top was completely open. Small dragon hatchlings could be seen flying freely under the mantle of light that fell and illuminated the throne room.
In the corner opposite where the young people entered, stood the throne of the Grand Duke of Vaeldrinn and patriarch of the dragon peoples.
It was large, as if carved from the open jaws of a dragon, with a man sitting atop it, stroking a winged beast on his lap.
His eyes opened, revealing piercing red irises that dominated his handsome, albeit slightly aged, face.
He stood up, his long black hair cascading over his powerful
shoulders, his blood-red horns glinting in the light.
'So this is the man I need to kill...! Qingyi subtly probed Patriarch Vaeldrinn, stopping only when he noticed the pair of red eyes focusing on him.
He was powerful, to be sure, but...
Qingyi smiled slightly.
He could kill him.
He would bleed for it, but he could most certainly kill him.
"A group of very lively young people, I see... The patriarch seemed to click his tongue.
He found this kind of ceremony tedious, a waste of his precious time.
Still, his father had always demanded that he attend them without fail; that he test and speak with the new champions.
In his opinion, these filthy humans shouldn't even be given the chance to try to be part of something greater, to be purebloods.

The patriarch sighed, extending his aura, imbuing it with a slight thread of murderous intent and letting it fall upon the young people. "Many of you will fail," he said, forcing kindness and honor into his voice.
"But for those who succeed, eternal glory awaits you. Not as mere humans, but as the rulers of the skies!
The chosen champions trembled at those words.
The rulers of the skies, side by side with the powerful experts they could only watch from afar in their childhood.
That was all they wanted.
The patriarch continued his speech for long seconds, with words of power and encouragement.
He even gave the young people some gifts before finally letting them
go.
Everyone was ecstatic, except for Qingyi, of course.
His face was cold, and his mind seemed to be in a completely
different place.
"Are you ready, my love?" he asked in his mind, directing his voice to Ruxue.
Of course, the spiritual beauty knew that it wasn't her Qingyi was talking to. After a moment of waiting, a sweet and lively voice that he knew well came.
"Yes, hubby!"
A few kilometers away, in the northern corner of the flying island,
stood a mansion.
It was large enough for dozens of servants and hundreds of guests, with accommodations that would make kings jealous.
Training rooms, a stream for fishing, and even a private theater.
But none of it was being used.
The place was empty, with only five servants keeping everything running, besides, of course, their master.
Seraphine Vaeldrinn Valerio. Daughter of the current patriarch of the dragon elves and member of the noble house that had ruled the
Grand Duchy of Vaeldrinn since its founding.
She sat in the shade of a cherry tree. Her bare feet, small and delicate,
were submerged in the running water of a stream that passed by.
Her eyes were closed as she meditated and enjoyed the birdsong.
She placed her hand on her chest, feeling her heart beating strongly. She was feeling strange, but not in a negative way.
Her cheeks were rosier than usual and her chest carried a positive
feeling.
"My lady...
A voice echoed from behind Seraphine, who immediately turned around.
There, she saw a woman kneeling, her body clad in powerful black
armor.
"I have chosen a champion... A man who seemed not to be of this world, but..." The words stuck in Viola's throat.
"What?" Seraphine stood up.
She had been with that guard her entire life and knew her well. For
her to hesitate like this, something big must have happened.
"Lord Lucios invited him to be his disciple, even offering one of his granddaughters in marriage to him. Yet, not only did the young man refuse, but he even demanded that he specifically become your
champion."
Seraphine herself couldn't help but let her face fill with strangeness
upon hearing
that.
Refuse Lucios? Her grandfather? What kind of madman would do
such a thing?
"When I questioned him, he said he already knew you." Viola's next
words made Seraphine's face fall.
"Where is he?" Seraphine asked.
"Young lady, before I introduce him to you, I need to make sure you're
safe. What if he's dange-"
"Bring him here. Now." Seraphine ordered, putting force into her voice
and interrupting Viola's words.
The guard lowered her head and trembled, but in the end, she just gave in.
She stood up, left the courtyard, and when she returned, she had a man by her side.
"Leave us alone..." Seraphine asked the moment she saw that man.
He was different from when she first saw him, from when she saw
him through her subtle connection with the fragment of his soul on her plane.
But she knew well. However he had overcome all that and become so powerful so quickly, this was the man she was looking for.
Long Qingyi, the most beautiful man she had ever seen in her life and
the one her sister had chosen.
Viola opened her lips to speak against her mistress's decision, but
seeing the look in her eyes, she simply withdrew. Seraphine swallowed hard, tears filling her eyes. "My sister... Elize... Where is she?"

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - I missed you so much..
paragraphs: Seraphine felt a lump in her throat.
Qingyi grabbed the sword strapped to his waist, and in the next instant, the blade flashed brightly, materializing a figure beside him.
The figure had a mature face of transcendental beauty, purple eyes, and long, elegant hair of the same color.
It was Elize. Her precious Elize.
It was not a projection seen through eyes present on another plane, but her in the flesh, standing right there in front of her.
Seraphine opened her lips to say something, but nothing escaped her throat.
Elize trembled, looking at the woman before her.
It had been countless years since they last saw each other. At the time of their separation, Elize was just a little girl, but she still knew that face very well.
With trembling steps, Elize approached and raised her hands toward her sister's face.
Seraphine mimicked the gesture. The two touched each other's faces, feeling each other's warmth.
They shuddered and, after a brief moment of hesitation, finally embraced.

"I-I missed you so much..." Seraphine sniffed, pulling her sister against her chest as tears streamed down her face. "I'm so sorry... if I had been here, if I had been with Mom... I could have called Grandpa... I could have stopped everything..."
Elize listened to the apologies, struggling to put strength into her trembling voice.
"I-it's okay, we're here now, right? And hubby has already promised
that we'll never be separated again!"
Upon hearing those words, Seraphine was unable to stop a painful laugh from escaping her lips.
Her eyes rose to Qingyi. He had his back turned, granting them a little privacy.
She remembered when she first met Elize and what her little sister had said to her.
'You can be my hubby's wife too...! Seraphine repeated in her mind, blushing immediately.
Her little sister was joking when she suggested that she become his wife too... right?
What kind of woman would offer her husband to another like that?
Seraphine asked herself countless times, and the answer was always the same: Elize wasn't joking.
Seraphine pushed those thoughts away and hugged her sister even tighter.

"You know Father will never allow this, right...?" Seraphine forced the difficult words out of her throat. "Not after the Red death consumed Karlan's heart. If he finds out you're here and who Qingyi is..."
Seraphine bit her lower lip hard, wiping away her tears and strengthening her voice.
It wasn't easy to say, but she knew, or at least believed, it to be true.
She was weak, and she was sure that in the current situation, her grandfather simply wouldn't act.
"Don't worry, hubby will kill that filthy pig, and after you become his wife, we can run away together!" Elize declared, pulling away from the embrace to look into her sister's eyes.
Seraphine froze.
Her eyes fluttered, alternating between Qingyi and Elize nonstop.
She didn't doubt Qingyi's ability to kill her father, as she had seen his talent firsthand. His current power, even with a mana heart inferior to hers, was still infinitely superior.
In the mortal heavens, he had ascended to the peak in the blink of an eye, and even here, his advancement had not slowed down.
He was, without a doubt, the most talented young man she had ever seen in her entire life.
Even the fact that he clearly had a mana heart despite being a Qi cultivator no longer came as much of a shock to her.
Seraphine swallowed hard. She searched her mind and heart for answers, but found none.
She hesitated repeatedly before finally getting up, keeping Elize by her side and walking towards Qingyi.
The handsome young man stood up, turning to face the two sisters.
They stood side by side, their hips pressed against each other.
The sides of Elize's huge, soft, snow-covered twin mountains touched Seraphine's full, perfect snow-covered twin peaks.
Their purple hair met over their delicate shoulders.
Elize's exaggerated and obscene curves contrasted with her sister's elegant and sensual curves, much more so than her pointed ears and black horns.
They were so similar, yet so different... both perfect in their own way.
"My little sister loves you, and... I believe you love her too..." Seraphine said, looking at Qingyi.
From his handsome face and protective smile to his broad, strong shoulders and everything below.
He seemed like the perfect man: handsome, protective, and full of love for his wives.
Was it worth it for Seraphine to give herself to him? No... did she really need to give herself to him?
Qingyi wouldn't demand that she become his wife just to stay by her sister's side forever, right?
"I wouldn't do that," Qingyi replied, eliciting a squeal of surprise from
Seraphine.
It was as if he had just read her mind. Not that, in her current state, she was able to hide her expressions very well.
"W-what do you..." Seraphine asked hesitantly for clarification.
"I wouldn't force you to be my wife in order to stay by Elize's side forever." Qingyi replied firmly.
"If you want to give me your heart, I will gladly accept it. Your
enemies will be my enemies, and I promise to protect and love you... If you don't want to give me your heart, I still promise to protect and love you, for I know it would make Elize happy."
Seraphine's eyes lowered, unable to meet Qingyi's piercing gaze.
The tears on her beautiful face had already dried. She placed her hand on her chest, feeling her heart beating wildly.
She looked at her sister, whose tears had also dried, her face filled
with excitement and expectation.
This was probably the happiest day of her life.
"Do you really promise?" Seraphine asked for confirmation. Receiving a nod from Qingyi, she moved her hands to the neckline of
her dress.
She hesitated for a few long seconds, her face flushing as a strange warmth rose from her groin.
In the end, she forced herself to be determined, grabbed it tightly,
and pulled.
The unmistakable sound of fabric tearing reached Qingyi's ears, and soon, Seraphine's dress fell to the floor.

He clenched his fists, feeling a potent mixture of Qi and Mana invading his meridians. It took only a single second for him to be fully recovered again.
"I think that's enough..." Qingyi muttered, testing his own power.
With quick steps, he left the cultivation room where he had isolated himself in the temple. Immediately, he came face to face with the anxious figures of Seraphine and Elize.
Knowing that he was about to contact their father right now, without a doubt, made them much more anxious than just knowing that he would do so at some distant point in the future.
"Don't you dare hurt yourself too much, okay?" Elize whispered, throwing herself into Qingyi's arms.
"I won't, don't worry." He leaned down, placing a soft kiss on her lips and feeling the weight of those huge tits against his chest.
Soon after, he raised his gaze to face Seraphine, also pulling her into his arms and planting a kiss on her lips.
"Should we go?" she asked, her voice clearly reluctant.
She just wanted to stay there until the last of the stars in the sky died, enjoying the company of her sister and, of course, Qingyi's other wives.
But in the end, she knew she couldn't, not yet.
She felt Qingyi's touch tighten a little more, and with a quick movement, the two disappeared, reappearing at her mansion.
The house had been empty for weeks, time she had spent doing nothing but being fucked by Qingyi and relaxing with her sister. Still, the place was perfect.
Not even a single speck of dust dirtied its floors, and not a single tree leaf seemed to have fallen across the endless concrete paths of its garden.
Qingyi felt a little strange when he noticed this. Seraphine, on the other hand, barely paid any attention to it.
"I'll call Viola and my servants. You can stay here if you want," she said, heading inside her mansion and leaving Qingyi alone in the garden.
"Ah..." The handsome young man took a deep breath, sitting down on a stone bench and closing his eyes.
It had been a long time since he had taken a few minutes just to meditate and decide on his next steps.
Unfortunately, his meditation did not last long, and suddenly, his body stiffened.
His eyes widened, and every fiber of his being screamed in alarm, ordering him to move.

His body was swallowed by a spatial fold, and the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword cut through the air, tearing everything in front of it. "Oh... Apparently, you really accepted my proposal without even realizing it, huh? Hahahaha!" A laugh echoed, and the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword stopped abruptly between the two fingers of an expert.
It was Lucios. His eyes were filled with amusement as he lightly pressed his fingers against the blade of Qingyi's sword.
He couldn't hide his surprise when he realized that no matter how much power he put into it, nothing happened.
Not even a single sign of material fatigue appeared on the blade.
Lucios hastily retracted his finger, hiding his embarrassed face.
What the hell was that sword that brat was using? He wanted to break it and use that as an excuse to shower him with gifts.
"Cough... Cough..." Lucios coughed, pretending to clear his throat.
"Come, young man, sit beside me, let's have a little chat!" He smiled, patting the empty space on the bench.
Qingyi naturally hesitated at that request, watching the old man in golden armor in front of him with suspicion.
He remembered when he was in a carriage with Meilin, watching reality itself being cut through an entire continent because of a friendly duel between experts from the Astral Body Realm.
Lucios was one of these experts, his power capable of affecting an entire continent.
Even if Qingyi could wreak destruction hundreds of kilometers around him if he used his maximum power, it was still incomparable
to Lucios.
In the end, what else could he do but sit next to the old man?
"So, when do you plan to have the wedding?" Lucios asked.
He took a small metal flask from his space ring along with two small cups, pouring a little for himself and Qingyi as well.
The moment he smelled the strong aroma of that drink, Qingyi's eyes widened. Was that... whiskey?
Without hesitation, he took the cup from Lucios' hands, drinking it in
a single gulp.
It wasn't exactly a drink he enjoyed, just one that wasn't available in the system and that he missed a little.
Feeling the sweet, warm liquid go down his throat, he couldn't help but feel a little better.
Why did his father-in-law have to be that damn cuckold patriarch and not this friendly old man?
"Where did you get this?" Qingyi asked, his eyes shining as Lucios
poured him another sip.

"From the body of a stranger from your land that I killed a few tens of thousands of years ago. He talked a lot, unfortunately, not enough to make up for his pathetic combat skills, hahaha." Lucios laughed, patting Qingyi on the shoulder.
"Now answer me, young man: when will you want to marry my granddaughter and become my heir? She's beautiful, isn't she? She inherited all the good from her mother and none of her father's flaws."
"That will depend on her," Qingyi replied, relaxing next to Lucios and not denying the old man's words.
Honestly, he had expected a grumpy and arrogant old man. But that was not the case.
Lucios seemed to be a good-humored man, the type who did not let his current level of power cloud his view of people.
He was infinitely more powerful than Qingyi, but still, he didn't mind lowering himself to his level to drink and chat casually.
Men like him were rare in this world.
'I hope I don't have to kill him...' Qingyi whispered to himself.
As he took a last sip of whiskey, he sent some to his space ring. Later,
he would take it to Feiyan and Biyue.
They would probably be able to reverse engineer it to recreate it.
Considering how rare such a drink was in this world, Meilin would probably be able to make a fortune with it.
Especially if they managed to imbue Qi materials into the recipe.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 Unfinished business
paragraphs: Seraphine had barely taken a step outside her mansion before she came to a complete halt, her body stiffening as she took in the scene before her.
Her grandfather, Lucios Vaeldrinn Valerio, was sitting there, drinking and chatting casually with Qingyi.
The old man's eyes shifted slightly, landing on her.

"Hey, granddaughter! So it was because of this guy that you rejected all the marriage proposals I arranged for you, huh? You've truly made your grandpa very proud, hahaha!" The old man laughed loudly.
His face was filled with amusement as he watched Seraphine's cheeks change color, turning an intense, fiery red.
She looked away, shuddering.
"Grandpa... this... this isn't..." She stammered, unable to form words.
"It's okay, kid." Lucios stood up. "Ugh... these old bones..." He grunted softly, cracking his back.
"This old man approves of your choice." He smiled. "I've already got one foot in the grave, I can't keep meddling in the hearts of the young."
Seraphine just stared at the floor, trembling slightly.
On the one hand, she was happy to have received her grandfather's approval.
She knew full well that if he had been there, he would never have allowed anything to happen to her mother, and honestly, she didn't blame him.
In the end, many people's lives depended on him. He couldn't just be paying attention to everything her father did all the time.
Still, there was bitterness in her heart.
Not that it mattered much, since this would be her last day on this land.
Soon, Qingyi would kill her father, and together, they would run away.
After a moment of hesitation, she spoke, her voice low and sweet: "Thank you, Grandpa..."
"Ah..." Lucios stood up, giving Qingyi's shoulders one last firm squeeze before turning away.
"Take good care of my granddaughter, young man." He said, and with a smooth movement, he disappeared.
To any other observer, it looked like he had used a teleportation skill, but Qingyi could see clearly.
It was pure speed and such perfect Qi control that the air around him didn't even move, taking a whole second for his body to be missed.
"You... you won't fail, right?" Seraphine asked, approaching Qingyi and hugging him tightly.
"No. Maybe if I had to fight your grandfather, but if it's just me and your father, there's no way I can lose." Qingyi said, his voice sweet and warm, his lips landing on Seraphine's forehead.
"I'm sure Khaedryss feels the same way about her chances against RedDeath," he added.
"Knowing her... I highly doubt she even considers him worthy, hahaha." The beauty laughed bitterly, but her voice soon turned
serious.
She looked at Qingyi with a complicated expression, but in the end, she said nothing, forcing herself to be strong.
She was too old to be whining about these things.
"Viola will be here soon, and then we can leave," she declared, exchanging one last kiss with Qingyi before walking away.
A few miles away, in the center of the enormous island floating above DragonPeak, capital of the Grand Duchy of Vaeldrinn, things couldn't be more exciting.
Hundreds of dragons of various sizes tore through the skies, flying over a huge statue: the mausoleum of Karlan, known as the mother of all dragons, her massive skull serving as the entrance.
The statue's scales were pure and perfect silver, reflecting with an incomparable shine.
Usually, there would be no more than a few thousand purebloods in that region, as many were responsible for managing their own
territory.
But this was no ordinary day.
Wealthy merchants, lesser dragon riders, and great land lords were
present.
Tens of thousands of purebloods, all gathered there for one thing
alone.
The rise of the RedDeath and the birth of a new beast whose power
likely rivaled Khaedryss.

For the less powerful, this was already something they could only dream of, imagining the level of power their people would now achieve with such a powerful beast that currently accepted riders. Neither the empire nor their arrogant cousins would dare to stand in their way.
For the more powerful, those who already knew that Khaedryss had indeed disappeared and not just isolated herself, this was something
even greater.
RedDeath would close one of the most troubling holes in their
defenses: the fact that Lucios was getting old and that they simply did not have a single specialist with the prospect of reaching the twelfth ring in the next ten thousand years.
In the end, above personal quarrels and political conflicts, the preservation of their people was the most important thing to them.
Qingyi really wished humans were like that.
'It's really crowded here, huh?' he thought to himself as he approached Seraphine and Viola.

He was one of the only "Humans" there, along with the other chosen champions, whose numbers had already been reduced from fifty to less than forty, all the others failing to live up to the expectations their recruiters had for them.
Naturally, the reward for failure was nothing less than death.
As he accompanied Seraphine, he kept his head down, even lower than Viola's, pretending to be nothing more than a loyal and obedient
servant.
There was some strangeness on the part of the guards when Seraphine chose to take him with her to her private box, one of many reserved only for the highest nobility to watch the ascent.
But, obviously, they did nothing to stop her.
Young Miss Seraphine had always been a little strange anyway, and
even if they wanted to stop her, what could they do?
One wrong word and they were sure Viola would not hesitate to rip their throats out.
Upon arriving at her private box, Seraphine sat down on a luxurious
throne, her eyes falling on the open courtyard in front of her and the huge silver statue that stood above Karlan's mausoleum.
She turned her face slightly toward Qingyi, whose eyes were focused
on the skies.
On the horizon, he could clearly see a figure approaching, scarlet
scales glinting across the skies as its roar engulfed everything around
it.
It was coming. It was time for him to settle some unfinished business.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 Please reconsider!
paragraphs: The patriarch of the draconic elves leaped from Red Death's head, his body accelerating rapidly before beginning to slow down a second before hitting the ground.
A powerful shockwave spread out, kicking up dust.
Behind him, Red Death's wings beat hard, forcing all spectators to cover their faces from the violent winds.
The patriarch stood still for a brief moment, watching the dust settle.
A slight smile spread across his aged but handsome face, his blood-red eyes sweeping over the crowd, briefly resting on his daughter before moving on.
Behind him, Red Death roared, and everyone except the thrones fell to their knees.
"We salute the patriarch!" they shouted in unison.
"Very well..." The patriarch's lips curved as he clapped his hands.
He appeared to be addressing the crowd, but in reality, he was applauding himself.

"I am proud to have you all here, accompanying me as I take the most important step in our civilization! Humans and our cousins from the east have been complacent with us, invading our territories, killing our people. But today, all that will change."
The patriarch turned, approaching the mausoleum. The enormous jaw of the skull opened even wider, enough to swallow even Red Death.
From within, a stone gate began to open.
"When I rise again, you must gather all your troops, every dragon and knight of fighting age, for together we will bring death to our
enemies!" the patriarch declared with force.
The most extreme shouted with excitement while the moderates watched their leader in shock.
What the hell did that bastard mean by that?
They had been in relative peace with the empire for over five hundred years, a peace that he himself had forged!
Did he want to tear up all the treaties that had guaranteed the
stability of his people for so long?
Everyone turned their faces to Lucios, who watched everything with
a bored and disinterested expression.
He was the most powerful expert of his people, he had to do something!
Unfortunately for them, Lucios did not move.
He continued to drink relaxed, as if that matter was not even his
concern.
"Patriarch, please reconsider!" One of the moderate purebloods stood up, a powerful warrior of the eleventh ring and leader of one of the twelve great families.
Unfortunately, his words fell on deaf ears.
He gritted his teeth, his hand reaching for his sword.
If the patriarch would not act, he would!
However, in the next moment, he had to change his mind. Twenty powerful auras fell upon everyone there, each belonging to an expert
from the peak of the eleventh ring.
Their bodies were covered in cloaks, their crimson armor shining in the sunlight.
Those were members of the patriarch's personal guard.
Grinding his teeth, he sat back down, swallowing his anger.
The patriarch shook his head, ignoring the discomfort.
From the open jaw of that huge skull, he saw a sea of pure white light surge forth, so intense, so perfect.
Just looking at it was enough for him to feel his heart struggling to escape his chest.
The patriarch's lips began to curve more and more as he walked toward the light.
There, everything was already prepared for the beginning of his dragon's ascension.
Stopping a few inches from the huge gate, he took a step forward, followed by Red Death right behind him.
The moment they both disappeared inside the gate, it began to slowly
fade away.
"It's time..." Qingyi murmured, moving his spatial Qi, his hand closing around Seraphine's delicate wrist, sending her toward the world of
the mind.
"You bastard, how dare you!" Viola roared behind him, but he couldn't pay any less attention to her.
Her saber slid out of its leather sheath with a loud, sharp whistle,
cutting through the air toward Qingyi's neck.
She didn't ask for an explanation for what had just happened.
All she knew was that her young mistress was probably in danger.
That was all she needed to know to act!
Her blade barely managed to scratch Qingyi's skin before sliding through empty air, his body suddenly disappearing.

The patriarch's guards also moved, forming a steel barrier in front of the gate, everything around them collapsing as their manas expanded. Trees were incinerated instantly, the temperature of the surrounding air reaching thousands of degrees Celsius in a single moment. They didn't care who got in their way, the important thing was that
that bastard couldn't enter that chamber.
Unfortunately for them, it was already too late.
The gates behind them slammed shut with a bang, their mana senses sweeping everything around them.
They couldn't sense the young man's presence, but they were sure.
They hadn't been able to stop him; he had entered with the patriarch!

"Lord Lucios!" The captain of the guard roared, turning to the patriarch's father. "Please give us permission to force the gate open! We cannot allow the patriarch's ascension to be interrupted." "Hm..." Lucios scratched his chin thoughtfully before replying, leaning forward in his throne. "It won't be necessary."
The moment his words fell, dozens of voices rose against him.
Even the most moderate, who totally disagreed with the patriarch's
plans, spoke out against Lord Lucios' decision.
What did their disagreement with the ambitions of a damn jerk matter
to Karlan's heart?
"Lord Lucios, please, even your granddaughter is with that young
man, don't you care about her life?" The captain of the guard insisted,
raising his voice even further.
The moment he received a stern look from Lucios, his eyes went to
the floor again.
He didn't dare say anything else.
"I understand your concerns." Lucios stood up. "My granddaughter is
fine, don't worry. As for my son..."
Pulsing veins appeared on Lucios' aged neck, his powerful mana crushing everyone there against the floor.
"If he can't even handle this brat, he doesn't deserve to be everything
he aspires to be."
Hearing those words, everyone's eyes fell to the floor. If that was Lord
Lucios' decision, so be it.

Grinding his teeth, he sat back down, swallowing his anger.
The patriarch shook his head, ignoring the discomfort.
From the open jaw of that huge skull, he saw a sea of pure white light surge forth, so intense, so perfect.
Just looking at it was enough for him to feel his heart struggling to escape his chest.
The patriarch's lips began to curve more and more as he walked toward the light.
There, everything was already prepared for the beginning of his dragon's ascension.
Stopping a few inches from the huge gate, he took a step forward, followed by Red Death right behind him.
The moment they both disappeared inside the gate, it began to slowly
fade away.
"It's time..." Qingyi murmured, moving his spatial Qi, his hand closing around Seraphine's delicate wrist, sending her toward the world of
the mind.
"You bastard, how dare you!" Viola roared behind him, but he couldn't pay any less attention to her.
Her saber slid out of its leather sheath with a loud, sharp whistle,
cutting through the air toward Qingyi's neck.
She didn't ask for an explanation for what had just happened.
All she knew was that her young mistress was probably in danger.
That was all she needed to know to act!
Her blade barely managed to scratch Qingyi's skin before sliding through empty air, his body suddenly disappearing.
The patriarch's guards also moved, forming a steel barrier in front of the gate, everything around them collapsing as their manas expanded.
Trees were incinerated instantly, the temperature of the surrounding air reaching thousands of degrees Celsius in a single moment.
They didn't care who got in their way, the important thing was that
that bastard couldn't enter that chamber.
Unfortunately for them, it was already too late.
The gates behind them slammed shut with a bang, their mana senses sweeping everything around them.
They couldn't sense the young man's presence, but they were sure.
They hadn't been able to stop him; he had entered with the patriarch!
"Lord Lucios!" The captain of the guard roared, turning to the patriarch's father.
"Please give us permission to force the gate open!
We cannot allow the patriarch's ascension to be interrupted." "Hm..." Lucios scratched his chin thoughtfully before replying, leaning forward in his throne.
"It won't be necessary."
The moment his words fell, dozens of voices rose against him.
Even the most moderate, who totally disagreed with the patriarch's
plans, spoke out against Lord Lucios' decision.
What did their disagreement with the ambitions of a damn jerk matter
to Karlan's heart?
"Lord Lucios, please, even your granddaughter is with that young
man, don't you care about her life?" The captain of the guard insisted,
raising his voice even further.
The moment he received a stern look from Lucios, his eyes went to
the floor again.
He didn't dare say anything else.
"I understand your concerns." Lucios stood up.
"My granddaughter is
fine, don't worry.
As for my son..."
Pulsing veins appeared on Lucios' aged neck, his powerful mana crushing everyone there against the floor.
"If he can't even handle this brat, he doesn't deserve to be everything
he aspires to be."
Hearing those words, everyone's eyes fell to the floor.
If that was Lord
Lucios' decision, so be it.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 Domain
paragraphs: The patriarch of the draconic elves appeared in a strange place, his feet stepping on damp ground, the sound of splashing water reaching his ears.
He was not in front of the gate through which he had entered, no.
He was miles below the earth, in a chamber so deep and narrow that not even he or his father knew exactly where it was.
All they knew was that this gate led to that chamber.
He took a step forward, observing a long corridor that stretched to an even larger chamber. Its ceiling rose miles above the floor, its length extending as far as the eye could see.
At the end of that chamber was the heart of Karlan.
The patriarch's pupils focused as he saw a group of figures, twelve in total.
They were the draconic priests and guardians of the remains of fallen heroes.
His most trusted advisors and, above all, the beings responsible for the ritual that would help RedDeath receive the power of Karlan's dragon.
After all, RedDeath was not like Khaedryss; he could not absorb the power of anything just by devouring it.
"What are you waiting for?" The patriarch smiled, the ground beneath his feet shaking as the Red Death took a step forward. "Let's get started-"
The patriarch's words died in his throat, the world around him changing as darkness swallowed everything.
He barely had time to react before he saw the hooded priests being torn in half by a wave of power, a hellish heat rising behind him.
He shielded himself with a thick layer of mana as RedDeath turned, his jaws opening to reveal endless rows of sharp, twisted teeth.
Its roar did little to drown out the explosion.
RedDeath's scales held, but the ground beneath his feet did not; his enormous body was thrown backward as his claws tore into the hard stone beneath him.

"Who the hell are you? Filthy pig! Reveal yourself!" The patriarch roared as he was also thrown toward the enormous chamber, a sea of flames leaving the hallway where they stood, illuminating the entire dark chamber.
A few moments later, even Red Death was thrown out, his enormous body landing on the stony ground with a thud.
"Filthy pig? Is that how you treat your son-in-law?" A voice full of disdain echoed, followed by a long, booming laugh.
The Patriarch's eyes rose, the huge beast above him roaring at a young man in the air.
He was handsome, with long black hair and piercing purple eyes, watching them with contempt.
That was one of the champions chosen in the last selection, the one who had been chosen by Seraphine!
The Patriarch gritted his teeth, unable to hold back his anger.
"So that's why that little bitch was confident enough to finally leave her damn hiding place? Hahahaha!" The Patriarch laughed wildly.
Suddenly, his laughter died and his eyes turned serious.
He could sense the mana leaking from Qingyi...
Tenth ring...
He had been thrown back like that by a bastard who was barely in the tenth ring?
Such a thought made the patriarch's blood boil with rage.
He couldn't accept that at all!
"Don't interfere!" He ordered RedDeath, who only shook his snout in annoyance.
In the next moment, the patriarch charged forward, his body turning into a blur as he broke the speed of sound, a long, elegant saber
appearing in his hands.
The moment the saber and the thunder sword that defied the
heavens met, the world around them seemed to collapse, the patriarch's crimson mana coming into contact with Qingyi's thunder Qi and Mana.
A reddish aura engulfed the entire enormous chamber, its stone walls shaking violently as millions of defensive arrays activated at once, preventing it from collapsing.
"Die!" The patriarch's roar sounded more like the desperate cry of a beast as he unleashed the full strength of an eleventh ring expert, the entire world around him changing.
'Is that... a domain?' Qingyi's eyes widened as he realized this change.
From the floor and walls, millions of tiny scarlet flowers began to
sprout, dominating everything around them.
Controlling his Qi became difficult, and all the mana surrounding him seemed to be violently sucked away.
He retreated, allowing the patriarch to win that clash, throwing him towards one of the chamber walls with a powerful crash, the
defensive arrays nearly collapsing.
"Ugh... damn.." Qingyi gritted his teeth.
Even breathing was difficult, and his body felt much heavier than
before.
His eyes fell on the world surrounding the patriarch, unlike anything he had ever seen before.
The small flowers had turned into giant roses, one by one blooming, hundreds of small thorns sprouting from each one.
"What's the matter... surprised?" The patriarch revealed a sickly smile, powerful roots sprouting from among the flowers, surrounding him
completely.
"That's what you get for messing with the wrong person, brat!"
The roots moved toward Qingyi, forming sharp points as the flowers released all their thorns at once.
Immediately, Qingyi felt a chill run down his spine, a sense of danger he had never felt before overwhelming his being.
He shuddered, gritting his teeth, his body quickly covered in powerful
black scales.
It made no sense to fight in the domain of the dragon elf patriarch; it
was a losing battle.
Qingyi had to find a way to break through it, or at least weaken it.
Gritting his teeth, he simply moved his draconic Qi, the enormous figure of a black dragon appearing behind him, its roar engulfing the world around him.
Red Death, who seemed uninterested in the fight, suddenly raised his head, roaring back at the dragon on Qingyi's back, his crimson eyes
filling with murderous intent.
Under Qingyi's bloodline suppression, the patriarch's momentum dropped significantly, but not enough.
The speed of the attack was still absurd, and its power had barely been reduced by ten or twenty percent.
A domain was, without a doubt, much more powerful than he had
expected.
"This is going to hurt..." The handsome young man gritted his teeth, preparing for the impact.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - How about a little fun too, girl?
paragraphs: "Damn it!"
Intense pain overwhelmed Qingyi as he was hit by thousands of projectiles at once.
The roots summoned by the patriarch moved like snakes toward him, striking his chest with powerful impacts.
The black scales withstood the initial blow, but soon he felt fatigue setting in.
He gritted his teeth so hard that his gums bled as he gathered his power.
With an explosion, he unleashed everything, shattering all the projectiles for dozens of meters.
"Oh... so you're not just an ordinary human, huh?" The patriarch laughed loudly, watching Qingyi's transformation.
He had barely finished his sentence before Qingyi was already upon him, his fist covered in black scales tearing through the air with full power.
The patriarch was struck. His nose sank into his face, his body spinning one hundred and eighty degrees before being thrown backwards like a cannonball.
He hit the ground with a thunderous explosion, powerful tremors engulfing everything around him.
Qingyi advanced toward him again, preparing the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, ready to tear him in two.
Unfortunately, the patriarch had already recovered. Dozens of powerful roots shot out of the ground around him, their tips as sharp as razors.
"Tell me, boy, what gives you such confidence to kill me?" The
patriarch roared, preparing his own sword.
He watched with amusement as Qingyi easily cut through his countless attacks, the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword slicing through everything around him.
Beneath the anger of having his priests killed and his plans delayed, his blood boiled. The powerful suppression of Qingyi's lineage only made him more excited.
It had been a long time since he had fought an enemy that forced him to sweat like this.
He charged forward, his body turning into nothing but a violent blur.
"Answer me, what did Seraphine give you? Become my subordinate, and I'll give you ten times more! I'll even make her your sex slave."
The patriarch's blade struck the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword with a deafening crash. Metallic sparks engulfed the air around them as the pressure rapidly increased.
"Oh... it's not just because of Seraphine that I'm killing you, filthy cuckold." Qingyi flashed a genuine smile.
He pushed the patriarch back before attacking again, his blade sliding past his enemy's and striking the guard of his sword.
"Ugh... FUCK!
A pained cry echoed, followed by exactly three severed fingers flying through the air, the patriarch's sword slipping from his hand.
His eyes widened, and he quickly drew a second sword from his spatial ring, grabbing it with his few remaining fingers and preventing Qingyi from decapitating him at that very moment.
How the hell did that bastard have so much physical strength?
Exchanging blows with him was like hitting a wall of solid steel.
"Not just because of Seraphine? What the hell do you mean by that?" The patriarch questioned, his face filled with pure hatred despite the
big smile that dominated it.
Qingyi laughed at the question. He swung the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, the movement wiping the blood from the blade and scattering it around in a crescent shape.
"Try to guess. Another daughter of yours, whom you abandoned and tried to kill like the pathetic, filthy cuckold that you are."
The moment those words echoed, the smile on the patriarch's face disappeared completely.
His domain shook. His fists clenched hard enough for his nails to tear the skin on his palms.
"Elize... so it's because of that damned cursed child... I knew it, she
would bring doom to my people!"
The patriarch gritted his teeth. His words sounded more like the growl of a hungry beast, his handsome face contorted into grotesque
expressions.
"No... you brought your own doom! I am merely the executioner who will deliver this doom to your pathetic little life." Qingyi corrected
him.
The patriarch's red eyes flashed with murderous intent as he roared.
"Red Death... devour him!"
Naturally, RedDeath couldn't be more excited to fulfill a request from his rider.
The pain from that blow he received upon Qingyi's arrival was still clear in his mind, as clear as the shame of not even being able to react
to such an attack.
His sharp claws tore into the ground for support as his jaws opened toward Qingyi.
The nearly hundred-ton beast of steel-hard scales and pure muscle
mass was ready to devour him.
Qingyi didn't move, the corners of his lips curving gently.
"How about a little fun too, girl?" he asked.
In the next moment, RedDeath froze, stopping its momentum and
trying to retreat.
He was a voracious beast, known for his insatiable hunger and uncontrolled violence, but he was not a stupid beast.
RedDeath sensed the danger keenly as Qingyi's blade flashed. A huge
head reared up, accompanied by a roar that was embedded in the
dragon's soul.
It was Khaedryss, RedDeath's attempts to retreat resulting in nothing more than revealing his unprotected neck to her, her jaws closing around his powerful scarlet scales.
With a powerful thrust, she continued to push the dragon back, feeling her teeth sink into the scales, a burning, powerful blood
entering her throat.
Red Death struggled.
His flames engulfed everything around him as he fought to turn his
massive body, using that momentum to pull Khaedryss off his neck. Free, he quickly retreated, just in time to take a breath of black, burning flames in his face.
Khaedryss gave him no respite.
It had been a long time since she had tasted such strong blood and
had such a good fight. She would not waste this chance. "Khaedryss..." Beside Qingyi, the patriarch muttered, struggling to hide his shock.
Were his eyes lying to him? Was that truly Khaedryss?
He shuddered, struggling to control his hatred.
He still remembered well when he was just a young man without
power and with a lot of arrogance, his foolish attempt to become Khaedryss's rider.
He only didn't lose his arm that day because his father intervened in
time.
Even so, his dignity was forever shattered, his pants soaked with urine as he screamed in horror in front of many other talented young men of his generation.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 Die in silence... pig...
paragraphs: That was the greatest shame of the patriarch's life, and he washed it away thoroughly, killing every last one of those who laughed at him, gouging out their eyes and beheading them.
Even so, the terror never left his bones.
Fortunately for him, it only took a single moment to realize.
That Khaedryss was not the same as she had been back then. Her current power was, at most, equivalent to RedDeath.
"Is that all you've got, brat? You dominate this shadow of what Khaedryss once was and think you have the power to face me?"
The patriarch shouted, rising to the skies. His mana coursed through his body with more power than ever as he flashed a bloody smile.
His domain grew for kilometers, engulfing the entire enormous chamber. The whites of his eyes turned black as night while his horns grew.
He discarded his saber, covered in small cracks, before retrieving another weapon from his space ring.
It was a saber, like his previous one, but much larger. The blade stretched for almost two meters, his body growing and his muscles swelling just enough for him to wield the weapon comfortably.
In the distance, the thunderous roars and infernal heat of the fight between Khaedryss and the Red Death could be heard.
Half the chamber was being engulfed by flames, the melted stone turning into nothing but burning magma that washed over the wounds spreading across the beast's scales.
Both the patriarch and Qingyi glanced once at the beasts' fight before advancing toward each other.
Their blades met only once before they retreated, their bodies
turning into blurred blurs, a sea of crimson mana and lightning
engulfing everything around them.
Neither of them held back, their swords meeting hundreds of times in
the short space between them in a single moment.
Everything around them disintegrated, the first defensive arrays beginning to fail as the battle spread.
A single attack struck a piece of the stone walls that was not perfectly defended by the arrays, sinking into the rock for nearly ten
kilometers, creating a crater large enough to fit a city.
The two were ready to advance against each other again when they were forced to separate.
Between them, a sea of flames broke out-no, it was more like an extremely dense black plasma laser.
Its heat was second only to Qingyi's primordial chaos flames, tearing through the stone as if it were paper, destroying much of the defensive arrays.
When Qingyi turned his face, he saw Red Death's sharp fangs sunk into Khaedryss's neck as her flames engulfed everything.
Her front claws clamped onto RedDeath's chest, tearing at his scales, burning blood spilling onto the ground.
With a beastly roar, she sent him flying before biting down hard, nearly tearing off one of his legs.
The two beasts paused for a moment, staring at each other and roaring, preparing the fire in the depths of their throats.
Both wanted to end it right there.
Qingyi sighed at the sight.
Dozens of wounds covered his body. Half of his ribs were torn, one of his lungs collapsed, and his heart was torn by the shards of one of his broken bones.
He was only alive right now because of the almost infinite vitality of a cultivator of his level.
"This fight has gone on long enough...

Qingyi prepared the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword. Sword, lightning, and flames engulfed the beautiful, sharp blade, the temperature around it rapidly rising, forcing the patriarch himself to take a step back.
What the hell were those damn flames surrounding that sword?
A single glance at them was enough to know: if he were hit by that, he would not end well.
Still, he did not retreat, also preparing his strongest attack, pushing all his mana toward his sword.
"Tremble before my greatness, wretched brat!" The patriarch roared, advancing.
At the same time, Qingyi took a single step forward, using the Heaven-Shattering Divine Slash.
Wherever his blade passed in its horizontal cut, a trail remained.
Flames and lightning, but not only that.
Space itself was tearing apart, the primordial laws being cut so perfectly that they barely noticed they were being divided, leaving a perfect, darkened, crescent shape behind.
The patriarch's blade met Qingyi's with frightening power, but it was
to no avail.
In the end, it was barely able to resist for a brief moment before the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword cut straight through it, flowing toward the abdomen of its bearer.
The scream that escaped his lips made even Qingyi shiver, guts falling to the ground alongside the upper part of a tall and powerful body,
blood spreading in untraceable streams.
"Ugh... damn it! No... this can't be happening..."
The patriarch struggled desperately, his eyes filling with even more terror as he saw two figures appear beside Qingyi.
"I told you not to hurt yourself too much, silly hubby..." One of the figures spoke, her sweet voice full of concern as she placed a kiss on
Qingyi's lips.
"I'm fine, dear." Qingyi laughed, returning Elize's kiss. "In fact, I've never been better."
His eyes fell on his dying opponent, the two beauties approaching
him.

"Oh... my dear little daughters... hahahaha..." The patriarch crawled across the floor. "Are you here for your daddy? Don't worry, I approve of your marriage to this man-no, not only that, I declare him my heir and will even tell you where I threw your mother's remains, I
promise-"
The patriarch did not have time to finish his promise as Elize took the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword from Qingyi's hands and thrust it into her father's chest.
Seraphine didn't stand idly by either, grabbing her own sword and, with a smooth movement, decapitating him.
"Die in silence... pig..." The two spoke in unison, their eyes filled with
rage.
In the distance, Khaedryss also ended her battle, using her sharp claws to pin RedDeath to the ground as her sharp teeth sank into his chest, reaching his heart and devouring it in one bloody bite.
She didn't care about the rest of the body, not yet.
She had more important things to eat for now.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 She's losing...
paragraphs: Khaedryss' footsteps echoed heavily, her claws tearing into the ground reddened by the hellish temperature that surrounded her, causing the air around her to bubble.
Behind her, she could sense the auras of Qingyi, Elize, and Seraphine. Through her subtle connection with her rider, she could also sense his injuries.
It had not been an easy battle for either of them.
With a low growl, Khaedryss continued to move her injured body. Her wounds slowly closed, and her burning blood ceased to bathe her black scales in red.
On the horizon, she could already smell a sweet scent, an aroma she had not smelled in tens of thousands of years.
It was the scent of a respected and ancient opponent of Khaedryss, or at least, of her heart.
Karlan.
Her heart was massive, easily the size of an elephant and weighing over four tons.
It lay on a huge stone platform, and even though she had been dead for tens of thousands of years, the organ still beat.
It still pumped blood through invisible lines, its mana richer than anything Khaedryss had ever felt in her life.
It was as if Karlan's heart had just been removed from her body.
Khaedryss stopped in front of the heart and turned her face slightly, watching Qingyi approach.
"Are you okay, girl?" he asked, stroking the hard scales on the dragon's neck.
The energy of the Seed of Life, which he had received from the
matriarch of the fox people, had already begun to work its way through his body, healing him of all his wounds.
Khaedryss just looked back at the heart, her jaw opening and her sharp teeth sinking into Karlan's organ.
She lifted it into the air, blood streaming like waterfalls down her powerful black scales.
With a smooth movement, she opened her mouth before closing it, swallowing the entire heart.
Her mana was already boiling from absorbing the power of the Red Death's heart, but nothing compared to what she felt next.
She took a step back, her jaw opening in a guttural roar as her body burned with flames, radiating heat capable of hurting even a dragon.
Beside her, Qingyi retreated, forming a barrier of Qi around himself and his wives, pulling them into his protective embrace.
"Ugh... what's going on?" Elize asked, turning her eyes to her sister, who had frozen, unable to speak.
Qingyi just gritted his teeth. T
he stones beneath his feet were being torn away, everything around Khaedryss being sent flying in a powerful explosion of mana.
Her enormous body floated in the air, an orb of black flames over five hundred meters in circumference surrounding her.
Her scales began to change, slowly cracking. A golden cocoon began to engulf her body as she shrank smaller and smaller.
Qingyi, with his draconic eyes active, could only watch, struggling to prevent the violent energy from shattering everyone there.
"She's losing..." Seraphine whispered beside Qingyi, turning her face toward the exit of that place before looking into her husband's eyes.
"We need to leave as soon as her energy calms down. Grandpa will be here soon."
Qingyi just nodded silently.
He was exhausted, and even if he wasn't, he would still have no
chance against an expert like Lucios.
Slowly, he felt the energy leaking from Khaedryss calm down, the sea
of flames surrounding her ceasing.
When everything finally stopped, Khaedryss was nowhere to be
found.
Where she should have been, there was only a huge, pulsating golden energy cocoon, surrounded by powerful black veins.
Qingyi didn't think or hesitate, sending the golden cocoon and the girls to the Mind World.
Immediately, he relaxed, starting to run toward the exit.
The portal through which they had entered was about to open again.
Outside, many watched the stone gates anxiously.
The Patriarch's guards looked ready to start throwing their swords at anything that appeared in front of them, while the many great Lords argued about what to do next.
Enemies or friends of the Patriarch, no one was happy or calm about
it.
No one except Lucios, of course.
The old man was relaxed, drinking as usual.
His huge bronze dragon had landed beside him, also watching the
portal.
He was the father of RedDeath and a direct descendant of the first line of dragons, the same lineage as Khaedryss.
Dragons were not usually very attached to their offspring, but in the end, they were beings of intelligence often superior to that of
humans.
Suddenly, the tranquility on Lucios' face disappeared and he raised his eyes.
The stone gate shook violently, a deep tremor spreading across the ground beneath his feet.
He stood up and, with a smooth movement, took a step forward.
In the blink of an eye, he was in front of the guards, waiting for the
gate to open.
When the intense light finally hit his face and he stepped forward, he
felt a slight distortion in the space around him.
A familiar presence appeared for a single moment before disappearing, reappearing kilometers away, and then fading away
completely.
Lucios turned his face sharply, staring at the horizon for a brief
second before sighing, walking toward the portal and entering it.
It took him only a moment to realize how devastating the battle there
had been.
The bodies of the priests were torn in half, and the temperature of
the entire place was so high that any mortal would be cooked alive in a matter of seconds.
He continued walking, feeling the temperature rise even higher, rivers
of magma surrounding the partially devoured corpse of Red Death.
His eyes scanned everything, noticing the absence of Karlan's heart before finally falling on the decapitated corpse of his son.
"Ah..." Lucios exhaled heavily.
"I failed you, just as you failed our-" Lucios stopped himself from continuing, correcting himself immediately. "My Seraphine...
"I don't blame her for wanting revenge, nor her man for taking it. You deserved it." Lucios opened a small bottle of alcohol, pouring it over
his son's feet.
He turned to the Patriarch's guards.
"We will hold a vote to decide the next Patriarch soon. For now, the entire Grand Duchy of Vaeldrinn will remain sealed."

Still, he didn't stop running.
Using every drop of Qi and mana, he continued until he found himself hundreds of kilometers away from the capital, where he finally

But for Qingyi, it was just a warm, gentle breeze.

energy.
[Just push all the mana toward the center, Khaedryss's own body will
do the rest.]

Forcing himself to continue, he pushed everything toward the center, ignoring his body's struggle and the screams of his meridians.

to make out a silhouette.
